{{Field procedure|topic=Mining|summary=Find a Planetary Mining Location, deploy the Rhino, place and manage mining rigs, collect their output, and transfer refined cargo to the carrier ship.}}

'''Surface Mining with the Rhino''' is the field procedure for planetary [[Surface Mining|surface mining]] with the [[Rhino]]. The Rhino's vehicle article owns its specifications, equipment list, crew capacity, and availability; this procedure covers the working mining loop.

== Before you start ==

* Use a carrier ship listed as compatible with the [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar]].
* Fit the hangar and a [[Detailed Surface Scanner]].
* Load the Rhino and leave room in the ship's cargo hold for refined commodities.
* Assign the Rhino's Planetary Mineral Scanner and Mining Rig Deployment Module to usable fire groups.
* Recover deployed rigs before leaving a site. Recorded field demonstrations show that active rigs can self-destruct when the Commander boards the carrier ship or leaves the active instance.<ref name="buur-guide">[https://youtu.be/5p-OZ-jXDbU FIRST LOOK: The Rhino Review & Surface Mining Guide], The Buur Pit, 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="mile13-guide">[https://youtu.be/5DbAmTJ4UG0 The Rhino Is Here! Early Access Surface Mining Guide], Mile 13 Gaming, 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

The Rhino Standard store page states that Odyssey is required to disembark from the vehicle for on-foot activity.<ref name="store-standard">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/product/rhino-standard Rhino Standard], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Procedure ==

=== 1. Find a Planetary Mining Location ===

{{Procedure steps|
# Enter a system with landable bodies.
# Use the system map and Full Spectrum System Scanner to identify candidate planets or moons.
# Approach a candidate body and map it with the [[Detailed Surface Scanner]].
# Check the resulting surface signals for '''Planetary Mining Locations'''. Frontier added this detection to the DSS in update 4.4.1.0.<ref name="frontier-4410">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous – 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 3 September 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
# Select a location whose reported resources fit the intended mining run.
# Descend toward the location and choose open terrain where the carrier ship can hold position for Rhino deployment and later recovery.
}}

Planetary Mining Locations vary in size, deposit density, deposit capacity, commodity weighting, replenishment, and temperature effects. Frontier has confirmed these as balance factors but has not published the formulae.<ref name="frontier-4410" /> A depleted deposit regenerates slowly, so a previously worked site may not provide the same immediate output on a return visit.<ref name="frontier-dev-log">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-august-dev-log-2026 Elite Dangerous: August Dev Log 2026], Frontier Developments, 27 August 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

=== 2. Deploy the Rhino ===

The Rhino drops from the carrier ship rather than using the ordinary landed-SRV cargo hatch. Recorded field demonstrations place the ship in a hover no more than about 30 metres above suitable terrain before the deploy control becomes available.<ref name="buur-guide" /><ref name="mile13-guide" />

{{Procedure steps|
# Fly the carrier ship over clear ground inside or close to the selected mining location.
# Lower the ship until the Rhino deployment control becomes available, without landing the ship.
# Deploy the Rhino and allow it to settle on the surface.
# Confirm the mining scanner and rig deployment module are assigned to the active fire groups.
# Drive into the Planetary Mining Location before beginning the deposit scan.
}}

For carrier compatibility and supported hangar classes, see [[Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar#Compatibility|Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar § Compatibility]].

=== 3. Locate a deposit ===

{{Context media|align=left|image=Planetary_mining_deposits_scan.png|caption=Deposit highlighting produced by the Rhino's scanner.|
Frontier describes the Rhino's scanner as marking mineral-rich deposits on both the terrain and the vehicle's sensors.<ref name="frontier-dev-log" /> The release notes call it the '''Planetary Mining Deposit Scanner'''; the Rhino announcement and store use '''Planetary Mineral Scanner'''.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="frontier-release">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/rhino-available-now-arx-early-access Rhino – Available Now Via ARX Early Access], Frontier Developments, 2 September 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
}}

{{Procedure steps|
# Pulse the Planetary Mineral Scanner inside the mining location.
# Watch the ground highlighting, sensors, and Contacts panel for detected deposits.
# Select a deposit to inspect its reported resource.
# Drive into the highlighted footprint and stop on terrain that gives the rig room to unfold.
}}

If the scan returns nothing, confirm that the Rhino is inside a Planetary Mining Location rather than elsewhere on the body.

=== 4. Deploy and manage mining rigs ===

[[File:Mining_rig.png|thumb|right|300px|A deployed Rhino mining rig extracting material from a planetary deposit.]]

{{Procedure steps|
# Stop inside the deposit's highlighted footprint.
# Activate the Mining Rig Deployment Module.
# Move away after deployment so the rig can unfold and begin mining.
# Scan for another deposit while the first rig works.
# Repeat until the available rigs are active or no worthwhile placement remains.
# Monitor deployed rigs through the Contacts panel.
}}

The Rhino can operate several rigs at once; recorded demonstrations show a maximum of six active rigs.<ref name="buur-guide" /><ref name="mile13-guide" /><ref name="slamscape-guide">[https://youtu.be/zBvg8SDV2F4 First Impressions – Rhino & Surface Mining Preview], Slamscape-X, 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref> Rigs require separation, and a large deposit can sometimes accept more than one rig when the valid footprints are far enough apart. The exact minimum spacing is not documented.

An invalid placement usually means the Rhino is outside the deposit footprint, the ground is unsuitable, or another rig is too close. Move within the highlighted area and try a flatter position with more separation.

==== Charging a rig ====

{{Community observation|Deployed rigs have an on-foot charging port that accepts the Energy Transfer Tool. Field demonstrations show the interaction changing the rig's efficiency display, but they do not establish a reliable universal change in cycle time or yield.<ref name="slamscape-guide" /><ref name="dynobot-guide">[https://youtu.be/8NRNn3lCzvo Elite Dangerous | Intro To Surface Mining], Dynobot, 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>}}

Charging consumes suit energy. It is optional to the basic vehicle loop and requires Odyssey disembarkation access.

=== 5. Collect output and recover rigs ===

When a rig finishes, its Contacts-panel actions distinguish collecting mined output from recovering the rig itself.<ref name="buur-guide" /><ref name="mile13-guide" />

{{Procedure steps|
# Select the completed rig in Contacts.
# Choose the action that prepares its minerals for collection.
# Wait for the rig to fold into its collection state.
# Drive the Rhino over the folded collection point to move the output into the onboard refinery.
# If the rig is to continue working, move away and allow it to redeploy.
# When leaving the deposit, select the rig again and prepare it for rig recovery.
# Drive over the folded rig and confirm that it returns to the Rhino's available rig inventory.
}}

Update 4.4.1.1 raised the maximum output of a mining rig from 9 chunks to 12.<ref name="frontier-4411">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-1 Elite Dangerous – 4.4.1.1 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 3 September 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

{{Warning|Collect completed output and recover active rigs before boarding the carrier ship, logging out, or leaving the active instance. Current field demonstrations show deployed rigs self-destructing when the operation is abandoned.<ref name="buur-guide" /><ref name="slamscape-guide" />}}

=== 6. Refine and unload ===

Recovered chunks enter the Rhino's onboard refinery and become commodity cargo. Frontier lists the Rhino with 72 tonnes of cargo capacity.<ref name="frontier-4410" /><ref name="store-vehicle">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/store/vehicles/rhino Rhino], Elite Dangerous Gamestore, Frontier Developments. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

{{Procedure steps|
# Watch the refinery and cargo capacity while collecting rig output.
# Recall or approach the carrier ship and request Rhino recovery.
# Drive into the projected recovery area and align the Rhino for boarding.
# Open the inventory-transfer interface while the ship is in recovery position.
# Transfer refined commodity cargo from the Rhino to the ship's cargo hold.
# Confirm that all wanted cargo and deployed rigs are secured before boarding or leaving.
}}

Surface mining may also produce additional Microresources. Frontier lists their frequency as a separate balance value, so they should not be counted as tonnes of refined commodity cargo.<ref name="frontier-4410" />

== Completion check ==

The run is secure when:

* wanted rig output has entered the Rhino refinery and cargo hold;
* refined commodity cargo has been transferred to the carrier ship;
* every rig that should be retained has returned to the Rhino's rig inventory; and
* the Rhino has boarded the carrier ship without active rigs left behind.

== Common problems ==

{| class="wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Problem !! Check
|-
| Rhino cannot deploy || Use a compatible ship and Large Planetary Vehicle Hangar. Hover over clear ground until the deploy control becomes available; do not use the ordinary landed-SRV bay workflow.
|-
| No Planetary Mining Location appears || Map the body with a Detailed Surface Scanner and check that the body actually has the new surface-mining signal.
|-
| Scanner finds no deposits || Drive inside the selected Planetary Mining Location before pulsing the Rhino scanner.
|-
| Rig placement is invalid || Stop inside the highlighted footprint, choose flatter ground, and increase separation from nearby rigs.
|-
| Completed rig cannot be collected || Select it in Contacts and prepare minerals or the rig for the intended type of recovery before driving over it.
|-
| Refinery or cargo is full || Transfer cargo to the carrier ship before collecting more output. Do not assume uncollected rig output is protected from loss.
|-
| Active rigs disappeared || Boarding, logging out, or leaving the instance can destroy deployed rigs. Recover them before ending the operation.
|}
